_help: Production constraints for the enforce-mode plugin itself, keyed to dependency-map.json node ids. The plugin is a dev tool, not a network service, so its constraints are runtime/quality budgets rather than QPS/SLO. See constraints.template.json for the service-shaped schema.

slo.availability: must never break the host session

load.qps: one invocation per Claude Code lifecycle event

hooks-runtime.data_sensitivity: internal — never log secrets/PII; secrets scanned, never stored
hooks-runtime.failure_tolerance: degrade-readonly — every hook try/catch → exit 0; a hook failure must not block the user

slo.availability: loaded as plugin agents; validated by tests/test-agents.js

agents.failure_tolerance: best-effort — a malformed agent fails its own test, not the suite
agents.notes: Each agent carries Domain DSA + enforce contract; see rules/mechanisms.md for inherited mechanisms.
